mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(qt.tag_id) AS quoteCount FROM tag t JOIN quote_tag qt ON t.id = qt.tag_id GROUP BY qt.tag_id ORDER BY quoteCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName, COUNT(qt.quote_id) AS quoteCount FROM tag t LEFT JOIN quote_tag qt ON t.id = qt.tag_id WHERE t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY t.id, t.name
SELECT id FROM tag WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
